name: Origo Reader
tagline: An elegant ebook reader for EPUB, PDF, and text files
description:
Origo Reader is a clean, cross-platform ebook reader that handles EPUB, PDF, and plain text files with smart pagination that makes long books easy to read. It can also read your book aloud with built-in text-to-speech.

It syncs your library and reading progress over WebDAV, so your place in a book follows you between your phone and other devices.
